core_types.name: Manager
core_types.description: Shared controller lifecycle and dependency container

core_types.name: Controller
core_types.description: Reconciliation loop executor reacting to events

core_types.name: Client
core_types.description: Split client routing reads to cache and writes to APIServer

concurrency_model.type: Multi-Worker Goroutine Pool per Controller with Shared Cache
concurrency_model.synchronization: Internal WorkQueue locks, Cache Informer read-locks

cancellation_model.deadline_propagation: Parent Manager context cascades to all registered Runnables and Reconcile invocations
cancellation_model.leak_prevention: Manager gracefully waits for Reconcile workers via sync.WaitGroup on shutdown

retry_model.strategy: Exponential backoff via Reconcile.Result{RequeueAfter: duration} or rate-limited error requeue

boundaries.network: k8s REST client HTTPS queries and Informer cache watch streams
boundaries.os: Host process signals (SIGTERM, SIGINT) bound to context cancellation
